description: NON-BINDING, ADVISORY RESOLUTION. To approve the compensation of the Company's named executive officers, as disclosed pursuant to Item 402 of Regulation S-K, set forth in "Compensation Discussion and Analysis" and in the compensation tables and the accompanying narrative disclosure under "Executive Compensation" in the Company's proxy statement relating to its 2024 Annual General Meeting.
